mapper.select: SELECT S.SCHEDULE_ID, S.SCHEDULE_NM, S.DIAG_TYPE, S.DATA_MODEL_ID, DM.DM_NM AS DATA_MODEL_NM, S.DICT_ID, (SELECT DICT_NM FROM TB_STD_DICT WHERE DICT_ID = S.DICT_ID) AS DICT_NM, S.SCHEDULE_TYPE, S.REPEAT_CYCLE, S.REPEAT_TIME, S.REPEAT_DAY_OF_WEEK, S.REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH, S.CRON_EXPR, S.USE_YN, S.LAST_EXEC_DT, S.LAST_EXEC_STATUS, S.LAST_EXEC_LOG_ID, S.CRET_USER_ID, S.CRET_DT, S.UPDT_USER_ID, S.UPDT_DT FROM TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE S LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL DM ON DM.DM_ID = S.DATA_MODEL_ID WHERE S.SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}

SELECT SCHEDULE_ID, SCHEDULE_NM, DIAG_TYPE, DATA_MODEL_ID, DICT_ID, SCHEDULE_TYPE, REPEAT_CYCLE, REPEAT_TIME, REPEAT_DAY_OF_WEEK, REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH, CRON_EXPR, USE_YN, LAST_EXEC_DT, LAST_EXEC_STATUS, LAST_EXEC_LOG_ID, CRET_USER_ID FROM TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE ( SCHEDULE_ID, SCHEDULE_NM, DIAG_TYPE, DATA_MODEL_ID, DICT_ID, SCHEDULE_TYPE, REPEAT_CYCLE, REPEAT_TIME, REPEAT_DAY_OF_WEEK, REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH, CRON_EXPR, USE_YN, CRET_USER_ID, CRET_DT ) VALUES ( #{scheduleId}, #{scheduleNm}, #{diagType}, #{dataModelId}, #{dictId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{scheduleType}, #{repeatCycle}, #{repeatTime}, #{repeatDayOfWeek}, #{repeatDayOfMonth}, #{cronExpr}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{cretUserId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE SET SCHEDULE_NM = #{scheduleNm}, DIAG_TYPE = #{diagType}, DATA_MODEL_ID = #{dataModelId}, DICT_ID = #{dictId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SCHEDULE_TYPE = #{scheduleType}, REPEAT_CYCLE = #{repeatCycle}, REPEAT_TIME = #{repeatTime}, REPEAT_DAY_OF_WEEK = #{repeatDayOfWeek}, REPEAT_DAY_OF_MONTH = #{repeatDayOfMonth}, CRON_EXPR = #{cronExpr}, USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDT_USER_ID = #{updtUserId}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}
UPDATE TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE SET USE_YN = #{useYn}, UPDT_USER_ID = #{updtUserId}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}

UPDATE TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE SET LAST_EXEC_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, LAST_EXEC_STATUS = CASE WHEN LAST_EXEC_STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN LAST_EXEC_STATUS ELSE 'SKIPPED' END, LAST_EXEC_LOG_ID = CASE WHEN LAST_EXEC_STATUS = 'RUNNING' THEN LAST_EXEC_LOG_ID ELSE #{logId} END WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}

UPDATE TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE_LOG SET EXEC_END_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, EXEC_STATUS = #{execStatus}, ERROR_MSG = #{errorMsg}, EXEC_DURATION_SEC= EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - EXEC_DT))::INTEGER, DIAG_JOB_ID = COALESCE(#{diagJobId}, DIAG_JOB_ID), STRUCT_DIAG_ID = COALESCE(#{structDiagId}, STRUCT_DIAG_ID) WHERE LOG_ID = #{logId}
AND EXEC_STATUS = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT L.LOG_ID, L.SCHEDULE_ID, L.SCHEDULE_NM_SNAPSHOT, L.EXEC_DT, L.EXEC_END_DT, L.EXEC_STATUS, L.TRIGGER_TYPE, L.DIAG_TYPE, L.DIAG_JOB_ID, L.STRUCT_DIAG_ID, L.GOV_META_SEND_ID, L.BATCH_RUN_ID, L.ERROR_MSG, L.EXEC_DURATION_SEC FROM TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE_LOG L WHERE L.EXEC_STATUS = 'RUNNING' AND L.EXEC_DT < (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (#{minutes} || ' minutes')::interval) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_DIAG_JOB J WHERE J.DIAG_JOB_ID = L.DIAG_JOB_ID AND J.STATUS IN ('READY', 'RUNNING')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY H WHERE H.DIAG_ID = L.STRUCT_DIAG_ID AND H.STATUS IN ('READY', 'RUNNING')) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_GOV_META_SEND G WHERE G.SEND_ID = L.GOV_META_SEND_ID AND G.STATUS = 'RUNNING') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_BATCH_RUN B WHERE B.RUN_ID = L.BATCH_RUN_ID AND B.STATUS = 'RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_GOV_META_SEND SET STATUS = 'ERROR', END_DT = to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE STATUS = 'RUNNING' AND TRIGGER_TYPE = 'SCHEDULE'
UPDATE TB_BATCH_RUN SET STATUS = 'ERROR', END_DT = to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), ERROR_MSG = 'q-executor 재기동으로 중단됨' WHERE STATUS = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_ID, SCHEDULE_ID, SCHEDULE_NM_SNAPSHOT, EXEC_DT, EXEC_END_DT, EXEC_STATUS, TRIGGER_TYPE, DIAG_TYPE, DIAG_JOB_ID, STRUCT_DIAG_ID, GOV_META_SEND_ID, BATCH_RUN_ID, ERROR_MSG, EXEC_DURATION_SEC FROM TB_DIAG_SCHEDULE_LOG WHERE EXEC_STATUS = 'RUNNING'
SELECT STATUS FROM TB_DIAG_JOB WHERE DIAG_JOB_ID = #{diagJobId}
SELECT STATUS FROM TB_STRUCT_DIAG_HISTORY WHERE DIAG_ID = #{structDiagId}
SELECT STATUS FROM TB_GOV_META_SEND WHERE SEND_ID = #{govMetaSendId}
